name: Pad Thai

ingredients.name: rice stick noodles
ingredients.original: 250 g dried flat rice stick noodles

ingredients.name: chicken thigh fillets
ingredients.original: 500 g chicken thigh fillets, sliced into thin strips

ingredients.name: spring onions
ingredients.original: 4 spring onions, sliced, white and green parts separated

ingredients.name: roasted peanuts
ingredients.original: 1/2 cup (75 g) roasted peanuts, roughly chopped

ingredients.name: dried chilli flakes
ingredients.original: 1 tsp (2 g) dried chilli flakes, to serve

steps: Put the rice stick noodles in a large bowl, cover with just-boiled water and soak for 6-8 minutes until pliable but still firm in the centre. Drain and rinse under cold water - they finish cooking in the wok.
Stir the tamarind puree, fish sauce and brown sugar together in a small bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Heat half the vegetable oil in a large wok over high heat. Stir-fry the chicken strips for 3-4 minutes until browned and just cooked through, then set aside on a plate.
Add a splash more oil to the wok, pour in the beaten eggs and scramble for about 30 seconds until just set. Set aside with the chicken.
Heat the remaining oil in the wok over high heat. Stir-fry the garlic and the white parts of the spring onions for 30 seconds until fragrant.

Add the drained noodles and the tamarind sauce. Toss constantly over high heat for 2-3 minutes until the noodles absorb the sauce and turn tender. If your wok is small, do this in two batches so the noodles fry rather than steam.
Take the wok off the heat. Return the chicken and eggs, then toss through the bean sprouts, the green parts of the spring onions and half the peanuts - the residual heat keeps the sprouts crisp.
Divide between bowls and top with the remaining peanuts and a pinch of chilli flakes. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing over.
